items.rationale: The battery health waiver disapplies the below-80% exclusion in §2.6.8, and the swerve impact is covered under §2.6.2. The supplier report supports replacement under §7.1.10: one equivalent new laptop at an estimated €1,400 gross, with no evidenced salvage amount to deduct.
Section 7.1.9 limits replacement to the pre-loss specification, so none of the separately billed elective upgrade difference is payable.
The tablet's cracked screen is covered impact damage under §§2.6.2–2.6.4. Sections 7.1.7 and 7.1.10 support one installed screen repair at an estimated €280 gross.
Section 5.2.3 covers necessary diagnostics for both affected devices, including the laptop found uneconomic to repair. At €72 per device, the combined line is €144 gross, below the €250 event cap.
Sections 4.2.6 and 7.1.5 require the bag itself to have suffered insured damage. The undamaged bag's replacement is not payable.
Sections 3.5(f) and 7.1.8(e) exclude the entire charge for the replacement laptop's extended warranty.
Sections 3.5(d) and 4.3(c) exclude data recovery unless separately scheduled. The battery health waiver does not provide that cover.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes separately billed administrative charges, including those from a secondary provider, so none of the fee is payable.
